summary: Recorded the store property the measured gap depends on: the in-memory log store writes entries by index into a map and only tracks the lowest and highest index it has seen, so it accepts an entry whose predecessors are missing and then reports it as the store's last index - which is why the accepted append in the probe left index 4 above the hole at 2 and 3 - while the LogStore interface does not require that tolerance, so a store enforcing contiguity would handle that write differently. Added the anchor (inmem_store.go 69-81) and a behavior knowledge entry with its conditions and the account's related anchors. Validation returned valid with those two effects and no execution requested; that tolerance is now on the record as an assumption of the measurement rather than a guarantee of the interface.
